Meta.Title: Getting Started, Module 1: Set Up Scene
Meta.Objective: Start the server, open the Scene Composer, set up and export a scene.

Step.title: Start the server
Step.Instruction: Open Git Bash and go to the folder mccf_full. Start the server.

Guide.title: Appendix A: Setup and local models

Step.title: Open the Launcher

Media.caption: Start Edge Browser to Load MCCF_Laucher

Step.Instruction: Open the Edge browser and enter this address.
Step.Note: Select Dashboard, run the Diagnostic Reports, then return to the Launcher and select Scene Composer.

Step.title: Scene Setup

Media.caption: Enter name of scene and set attributes of grid.

Step.Instruction: On the Scene tab: name the scene GettingStarted, set Width and Depth to 40 metres, set Navigation to WALK and the transition time to 2 seconds. Click Apply Grid.
Step.Note: Expect a Grid toast after Apply Grid.

Question.title: Scene grid units
Question.Prompt: The scene grid is measured in:

Response.Feedback: Not feet. Every dimension in MCCF is in metres.
Right. Width, Depth, positions and radii are all in metres.
Not yards. Every dimension in MCCF is in metres.
Hint: In X3D, positive Z is out. negative Z is in. Y is up/down. X is side to side.

Question.title: Transition time
Question.Prompt: Transition Time sets how long a viewpoint change takes. The unit is:

Response.Feedback: Not milliseconds. Enter seconds, for example 2.
Right. Transition Time is in seconds.

Step.title: Export the scene
Step.Instruction:
Go to the Export tab and choose Export Scene. and zones.
To reopen a scene, Scene.xml MUST be exported X3D is not the record of authority. MCCF.XSD is. Scene.xml and Zone.xml are gospel.
Step.Note: Then go to the Scene tab, press the Load Scene refresh button and check the new file is at the top of the Saved scenes list.

Question.title: Saving a scene
Question.Prompt: To save the scene itself, go to the Export tab and choose:

Response.Feedback: Export X3D writes the file the Loader plays. It does not save the scene.
Export Zones writes the zones only.
Export Scene.xml and Export Zone.xml writes the scene file and zone file you load back as a composed scene..
